26:137.text: "This is no other than the false tales and religion of the ancients,

26:138.text: "And we are not going to be punished."

26:139.text: So they belied him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26:140.text: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26:142.text: When their brother Sâlih said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

26:143.text: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26:144.text: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26:145.text: "No reward do I ask of you for it
; my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

26:146.text: "Will you be left secure in that which you have here?

26:149.text: "And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill.

26:150.text: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26:151.text: "And follow not the command of Al-Musrifûn
[i.e. their chiefs: leaders who were polytheists, criminals and sinners]

26:152.text: "Who make mischief in the land, and reform not."

26:153.text: They said: "You are only of those bewitched!

26:154.text: "You are but a human being like us. Then bring us a sign if you are of the truthful."

26:155.text: He said: "Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink
, and you have a right to drink

26:156.text: "And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you."

26:157.text: But they killed her, and then they became regretful.

26:158.text: So the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26:159.text: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
